partition_policy.training: all target facts except source-exclusive validation and blind facts

results.name: Compact-paralog LOF compensatory activation
results.hypothesis: Increasing a distinct compact-family paralog can compensate for a loss-of-function disease driver.
results.body: drug increases bound target; target and LOF driver share p90-compact Panther family
results.mechanism_rationale: The drug direction is explicitly restorative and compact paralogy supplies a plausible functional bypass, although family membership does not prove compensation.
results.trapi_notes: The drug, family, and LOF paths are TRAPI-expressible; variant form, repeated family identity, compactness, and ontology constraints require post-processing.
results.cypher:
MATCH (subject:Drug)-[:DIRECTLY_PHYSICALLY_INTERACTS_WITH]->(target:Gene)
MATCH (subject)-[effect:AFFECTS]->(target)
MATCH (target)-[:MEMBER_OF]->(family:GeneFamily)
      <-[:MEMBER_OF]-(driver)
MATCH (driver)-[association:ASSOCIATED_WITH]->(object:Disease)
WHERE target <> driver
  AND effect.qualified_predicate = 'biolink:causes'
  AND effect.object_aspect_qualifier = 'activity_or_abundance'
  AND effect.object_direction_qualifier = 'increased'
  AND 'infores:gene2phenotype' IN
      coalesce(association.primary_knowledge_sources, [])
  AND association.subject_form_or_variant_qualifier =
      'loss_of_function_variant_form'
  AND family._miner_gene_family_member_degree <= 14
  AND coalesce(object._miner_disease_descendant_degree, 0) <= 500
  AND object._miner_disease_superclass_degree >= 1
  AND object.id STARTS WITH 'MONDO:'
RETURN DISTINCT subject.id AS subject_id, object.id AS object_id
